RE-SEATED from chair 1 to chair 3 by migration 1941. 🔴 THE HOUSING LADDER IS RESTRUCTURED BETWEEN SEASONS AND BOTH REVISIONS WERE READ BEFORE WRITING. Season 1 chair 2 was "Use rent caps, require new developments to include affordable units, and publicly fund new housing"; Season 2 inserted a new rung at position 2 and split that content, so Season 2 chair 3 now reads "Build no public housing, but set binding rules on the private market like RENT CAPS or required affordable units". Chair 1 is stable across both seasons - "Make government the main provider - build and operate public housing so everyone is guaranteed a home" - which is how we know this row is a genuine mis-mapping and not a renumbering artefact: rent stabilisation was chair 2 on the Season 1 ladder and is chair 3 on the Season 2 ladder, and was never chair 1 on either. 🔑 THE ENACTED TEXT WAS READ, NOT THE TITLE. 194/H2328, "An Act enabling cities and towns to stabilize rents and protect tenants", section 2 lets a municipality "impose a limit on the size of annual rent increases" and require just-cause eviction, and section 4(a) caps any annual increase at "the annual change in the Consumer Price Index for the applicable area or 5 per cent, whichever is lower". The act creates and funds NO public housing: it regulates privately owned units. Both of chair 3's limbs are therefore satisfied by the instrument, including the negative one, while chair 1's "government the main provider" is evidenced by nothing this row cites. ✅ The cosponsorships were verified on each bill's own cosponsor page by migration 1900 and those citations are carried forward unchanged.
